evidence.result: All 8 gates pass: fills match palette exactly; IoU 0.981-1.0 per shape (background 0.995); MAE 0.13-1.85 of 255; SVG and PNG reruns byte-identical; second run prints OK. resvg 0.47.0, ImageMagick 7.1.2.
evidence.scope: Colour mode, fixed settings: 3 flat shapes on white traced to SVG; fills match palette; resvg IoU and MAE per shape; reruns byte-identical; macOS arm64

summary: Raster-to-SVG vector tracing with a CLI and colour support. Useful for turning simple colour artwork into vector source; geometry and visual fidelity depend on settings and input.
use_when: Trace colour artwork to SVG rather than Potrace’s single-colour output
Explore raster-to-vector preparation for later SVG work
avoid_when: Need hand-edited semantic shapes: author SVG directly
Need faithful photographs: retain the raster image
license: MIT (project code; dependency and asset terms unassessed)
